WITH hand_tallies AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.throws), ''), '') AS throwing_hand,
        COUNT(*) AS tally
    FROM player_award AS pa
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pa.player_id
    GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.throws), ''), '')
), shares AS (
    SELECT
        tally,
        1.0 * tally / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share
    FROM hand_tallies
), scored AS (
    SELECT
        tally,
        share,
        AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM shares
)
SELECT
    SUM(tally) AS total_tally,
    AVG(share) AS average_share,
    AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM scored
WHERE share > average_share;

assumptions.assumption: Each matching player_award row counts as one award win; NULL, empty, and whitespace-only throwing-hand values form one group.
